sections.title: Species traits
lines: Medium Humanoid (Dwarf). +2 Constitution and −2 Dexterity. Base land speed 20 ft., retained in medium or heavy armor and under a medium or heavy load.
Darkvision sees in black and white out to 90 ft.

Stonecunning gives +2 racial on Search checks for unusual stonework, including material disguised as stone. A Dream Dwarf who comes within 10 ft. of unusual stonework can make a Search check as if actively looking.
Stonecunning also lets the dwarf Search for stonework traps as a rogue can and estimate approximate depth underground.
Weapon Familiarity treats dwarven waraxes and dwarven urgroshes as martial weapons.
Stability adds +4 on ability checks to resist bull rush or trip while standing firmly on the ground.
+2 racial bonus on Diplomacy checks with creatures of the earth subtype.
Dream Sight (Su) sees ethereal creatures as readily as material creatures. Ethereal creatures look translucent and indistinct, so the dwarf can tell them apart.

Spell Power adds +1 to effective caster level for divinations or spells with the earth descriptor when in contact with the ground. Apply the increase to level-dependent effects and caster level checks. It stacks with other Spell Power abilities.
Common and Dwarven are automatic. Bonus languages are Draconic, Elven, Gnome, Terran, and Undercommon. Favored class Druid. The entry lists no racial Hit Dice or level adjustment.

sections.title: Original NPC · Maera Dol-Vel
lines: Spring tender and Druid.
Motive. Find out why the animals no longer drink from the uphill spring.
Hook. Maera can speak with a badger from the bank while the party checks the spillway for what changed.
Dream Dwarf spring tender, Druid 1 · Provisional CR 1. ECL 1. · Medium Humanoid (Dwarf)
AC 15 · HP 11 (1d8+3) · Speed 20 ft.

sections.title: Original NPC · Ornek Tarn-Iol
lines: Seam reader and Expert.
Motive. Identify the old exit an ethereal traveler crossed just before a tunnel was bricked up.
Hook. Ornek can identify an unusual seam in the new stonework if the party brings the old floor plan.
Dream Dwarf seam reader, Expert 1 · Provisional CR 1/2. ECL 1. · Medium Humanoid (Dwarf)
AC 13 · HP 9 (1d6+3) · Speed 20 ft.
